reference_sql:
WITH first_pay AS (  -- one row per user who has paid
  SELECT s.user_id, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  GROUP BY s.user_id
)
SELECT date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts), date_trunc('month', f.first_paid_at)) AS months_to_first_payment,
       COUNT(*) AS users
FROM signups u
JOIN first_pay f ON f.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY months_to_first_payment
alternatives:
SELECT date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', signup_ts), date_trunc('month', first_paid_at)) AS months_to_first_payment, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM (  -- one row per 2025 user who has paid
  SELECT u.user_id, u.signup_ts, MIN(p.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
  FROM signups u
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE date_part('year', u.signup_ts) = 2025
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.signup_ts
) AS f
GROUP BY 1

solver.query:
WITH u AS (
  SELECT user_id, timezone('UTC', signup_ts) AS s FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
fp AS (
  SELECT s.user_id, timezone('UTC', MIN(p.paid_at)) AS f
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  GROUP BY s.user_id
)
SELECT date_diff('month', date_trunc('month', u.s), date_trunc('month', fp.f)) AS months_to_first_payment, COUNT(*) AS users
FROM u JOIN fp ON fp.user_id = u.user_id
GROUP BY 1
